s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding and mass
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts

exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy

differentials: Clear cell sarcoma of the ileum
Pheochromocytoma of the organ of Zuckerkandl
Primitive neuroectodermal tumor of the small intestine
Desmoplastic small round cell tumor of the peritoneum

per_call: Clear cell sarcoma of the ileum
Pheochromocytoma of the organ of Zuckerkandl
Primitive neuroectodermal tumor of the small intestine
Desmoplastic small round cell tumor of the peritoneum
Ewing sarcoma of the small intestine

shortlist.label: Clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, and histological features of a transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
shortlist.why_kept: Exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy and mucosal ulceration, although immunohistochemical analysis did not support this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Similar histological features and strong positivity for S100 protein, although SOX10 positivity is more characteristic of clear cell sarcoma

shortlist.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Some histological features, such as nested and fascicular patterns, are reminiscent of neuroendocrine tumors, although immunohistochemical analysis did not support this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Some histological features, such as a transmural, infiltrative proliferation, are reminiscent of desmoplastic small round cell tumor, although immunohistochemical analysis did not support this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The tumor's microscopic features, including a transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, and its immunohistochemical profile, with diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, are consistent with clear cell sarcoma.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
rejected.why: GISTs are typically positive for CD117, DOG1, or CD34, which were all negative in this case.

rejected.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: While S100 protein positivity is seen in MPNSTs, the clinical and microscopic features do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
rejected.why: The tumor's morphology and immunohistochemical profile do not support a neuroendocrine tumor, which would typically express chromogranin, synaptophysin, or CD56.

rejected.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
rejected.why: The tumor cells in this case are described as uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, which does not match the small, round, blue cell morphology of desmoplastic small round cell tumor.
